chunks: Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Sufyan ibn Yaqub ibn al-Harith ibn Ibrahim al-Hamdani narrated in his house in Kufa that Abu Abdullah Ja'far ibn Ahmad ibn Yusuf al-Azdi narrated that Ali ibn Bazraj al-Hannatt narrated that Amr ibn al-Yasa' narrated from Shu'ayb al-Haddad who said: I heard al-Sadiq, Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them), saying:

Indeed, our sayings are difficult and hard to bear; only a nearby angel, or a dispatched prophet, or a servant whose heart God has tested for faith, or a strong city can bear them. Amr said: So I said to Shu'ayb: O Abu al-Hasan, and what is the strong city? He said: So I asked al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) about it, and he said to me: The gathered heart.

key_terms.مَدِينَةٌ حَصِينَةٌ: A strong city (metaphor for a firm heart)

ai.seo_question: What are the four entities capable of understanding the deep sayings of the Imams according to al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the esoteric depth of the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings, noting that their complexity necessitates a heart fortified against doubt, metaphorically described as a 'strong city' (madina hasina). This interpretation aligns with Shia hermeneutics where spiritual resilience and inner unity are prerequisites for grasping divine secrets, distinguishing the true believers from the masses who may find the same traditions 'difficult to bear.'

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 4-27 Ali ibn al-Hussein ibn Sufyan ibn Yaqoob ibn al-Harith ibn Ibrahim al-Hamedany narrated in his house in Kufa that Abu Abdullah Ja’far ibn Ahmad ibn Yusuf al-Azodi quoted Ali ibn Bazraj al-Hanat, on the authority of Amr ibn al-Yasee’a, on the authority of Shoayb al-Had’dad that he had heard Ja’far ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq (MGB) say,

“Indeed our sayings are hard to understand. Only the following four can understand them: either a nearby-stationed angel; a dispatched Prophet; a servant of God whose faith has been tested or a strong town.” Shoayb al-Had’dad asked, “What do you mean by a strong town?” The Imam (MGB) replied, “I mean a heart with a firm belief.”
